card.name: Word before ethinyl estradiol in contraceptives
card.fires_on: The word "containing" right after oral or hormonal contraceptives, where ethinyl estradiol is likely to come next. Also linking words like "of" before estrogen in contraceptive interaction text.

modes.label: Contraceptives containing
modes.description: The word "containing" after a contraceptive phrase, just before a hormone ingredient name.
modes.example: coadministered with cabotegravir without a dose adjustment: etravirine, midazolam, oral contraceptives<< containing>> levonorgestrel and ethin

modes.label: Link before estrogen
modes.description: A small linking word in a contraceptive interaction sentence, before estrogen or progesterone.
modes.example: 7.6 Oral Contraceptives In vivo studies have revealed no effect of ziprasidone on the pharmacokinetics<< of>> estrogen or progesterone components.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the start of "ethinyl" (eth...) next and to avoid the word "exchange".
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name ethinyl estradiol in a birth control drug interaction.
